cohort: 2015-16 through 2024-25; ten completed seasons, 312 team-seasons. Frozen cohort chosen for NBA comparability, not all currently completed seasons.
rarityCohort: 250 team-seasons with exactly 82 regular-season games; exclude all 2019-20 and 2020-21 team-seasons because shortened schedules and different sampling variance change tail rarity.
rarityDefinition: Empirical midrank CDF = (# fewer wins + 0.5 * # equal wins)/N. Upper-tail frequency = # at least as many wins/N. Current 84-game inputs normalized using W/84 against historical W/82. Tail outside observed history is extrapolation; do not report 0% as impossible.
betterTeam: Use exact rational comparisons of regular-season wins/games (cross-products) to avoid floating-point tie errors. Also provide points/(2*games) alternative because NHL official standings use points and OT/shootout losers receive one point.
playoffDefinition: Only 150 completed best-of-seven series, rounds 1–4. Every winner and pair cross-checked against official playoff bracket JSON. Exclude 2020 qualifying best-of-five and round-robin games. 2020 main bracket remains and is identified as neutral bubble.
validations: Raw response data count equals reported total.
Regular-season games reproduce every team GP, wins and overtime/shootout losses; summed final scores exceed official goalsFor by exactly shootout wins.
Every retained playoff series reaches exactly four wins and matches official bracket.
All source responses cached with URL, retrieval time and SHA256.
limits: Final season records summarize whole regular season. Not an in-season prospective predictor.
Observed playoff rates confound regular-season strength gaps, home advantage, seed selection, injuries and roster changes; differences between sports cannot be attributed solely to scoring frequency.
NHL total wins include overtime and shootouts; playoffs use continuous overtime and no shootouts.
Wins-only inputs lose information from NHL overtime-loss points; points-percentage comparison is a sensitivity check.
Regular-season scores include shootout deciding goals; official goalsFor summary excludes deciding shootout tallies. Scoring frequency comes from official team goalsFor, not summing final scores.
Identically rare records across leagues do not imply identical playoff win probabilities; empirical rarity is a league-relative input, separate from sport and format mechanics.

verifiedOvertimePointException.detail: Official record counts this empty-net overtime loss as a loss without an overtime standings point.
